description: Structured eval definitions for the Amazon Keyspaces Keyspace Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Keyspaces topologies (on-demand keyspace+table with PITR and CMK encryption, provisioned mode with auto-scaling, composite partition+clustering key for sort order, client-side KMS envelope encryption, missing KMS key prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: On-demand Keyspaces keyspace and table with PITR and CMK encryption
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — on-demand keyspace+table, PITR explicitly enabled, CMK encryption, VPC endpoint with private DNS, composite partition key (user_id + event_date)
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Amazon Keyspaces keyspace called event_store in us-east-1. Create a table user_events with columns: user_id (uuid), event_date (date), event_time (timestamp), event_type (text), payload (blob). Partition key: (user_id, event_date). Clustering key: event_time DESC. Use on-demand capacity. Enable point-in-time recovery. Use KMS CMK alias/keyspaces-cmk for encryption at rest. Create a VPC endpoint in VPC vpc-aaa11122, subnets subnet-aaa111 and subnet-bbb222, security group sg-keyspaces-client. Tags: Environment=production, Team=data-platform.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KEYSPACES: event_store.user_events
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Keyspace: event_store — ACTIVE
  [✓] Table: user_events — partition key: (user_id, event_date), clustering key: event_time DESC
  [✓] Partition key cardinality: HIGH (user_id UUID + date)
  [✓] Capacity mode: On-demand (PAY_PER_REQUEST)
  [✓] Point-in-time recovery: ENABLED
  [✓] Encryption at rest: Customer-managed key (alias/keyspaces-cmk)
  [✓] VPC endpoint: private DNS enabled

eval_cases.name: Provisioned-mode Keyspaces table with target tracking auto-scaling
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — provisioned capacity with auto-scaling on read and write, target 70%, min 100 max 5000
eval_cases.prompt: Create a table sensor_readings in keyspace telemetry_keyspace. Columns: sensor_id (text), reading_time (timestamp), value (double), unit (text). Partition key: sensor_id. Clustering key: reading_time DESC. Use provisioned capacity with 500 read capacity units and 1000 write capacity units. Enable auto-scaling with target 70%, min 100, max 5000 on both read and write. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=iot-telemetry.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KEYSPACES: telemetry_keyspace.sensor_readings
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Keyspace: telemetry_keyspace — ACTIVE
  [✓] Table: sensor_readings — partition key: sensor_id, clustering key: reading_time DESC
  [✓] Capacity mode: Provisioned (read: 500, write: 1000) with auto-scaling
  [✓] Auto-scaling: target 70%, min 100, max 5000 (read and write)

eval_cases.name: Composite partition key and multi-column clustering key for sort order
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — composite partition key (customer_id + order_date), multi-column clustering key (order_type ASC, order_ts DESC) for range queries
eval_cases.prompt: Create a table order_history in keyspace commerce_keyspace. Columns: customer_id (uuid), order_date (date), order_ts (timestamp), order_type (text), amount (decimal), status (text). Partition key: (customer_id, order_date). Clustering key: (order_type ASC, order_ts DESC). This supports queries like get all returns for customer X on date Y, newest first. On-demand capacity. PITR enabled. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, Domain=orders.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KEYSPACES: commerce_keyspace.order_history
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Table: order_history — partition key: (customer_id, order_date), clustering key: (order_type ASC, order_ts DESC)
  [✓] Partition key cardinality: HIGH (customer_id UUID + date)
  [✓] Capacity mode: On-demand (PAY_PER_REQUEST)
  [✓] Point-in-time recovery: ENABLED

eval_cases.name: Client-side envelope encryption via KMS for PII data
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — client-side KMS envelope encryption on pii_data column, server-side CMK for encryption at rest, WHERE-clause warning on encrypted columns
eval_cases.prompt: Create a table pii_records in keyspace compliance_keyspace. Columns: record_id (uuid), customer_id (uuid), pii_data (blob), region (text), created_at (timestamp). Partition key: (customer_id, region). Clustering key: created_at DESC. The pii_data column must be encrypted client-side using KMS envelope encryption with alias/keyspaces-client-encryption. Also use server-side CMK alias/keyspaces-cmk for encryption at rest. On-demand capacity. PITR enabled. Region us-east-1. Tags: Environment=production, Compliance=pii.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KEYSPACES: compliance_keyspace.pii_records
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Table: pii_records — partition key: (customer_id, region), clustering key: created_at DESC
  [✓] Client-side encryption: KMS envelope (alias/keyspaces-client-encryption) on pii_data
  [✓] Encryption at rest: Customer-managed key (alias/keyspaces-cmk)
  [✓] Point-in-time recovery: ENABLED

eval_cases.name: Keyspaces table with nonexistent KMS CMK (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — KMS key alias/nonexistent-key does not exist; cannot reference a nonexistent CMK for encryption at rest
eval_cases.prompt: Create a table sensitive_data in keyspace app_keyspace. Columns: id (uuid), data (blob). Partition key: id. On-demand capacity. PITR enabled. Use KMS CMK alias/nonexistent-key for encryption at rest. Region us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KEYSPACES: app_keyspace.sensitive_data
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Encryption at rest: KMS CMK alias/nonexistent-key NOT FOUND — create the key before referencing it
